scope: Textbutler 0.8.22 version bump (devin/release-0.8.22): the per-release coordinate agreement — package.json, site/package.json, src/version.ts, site/app/_lib/site.ts, the README install line, regenerated site/app/readme.generated.ts, and the new CHANGELOG.md section — plus the receipt refresh because package.json is receipt-covered.

rounds.design: Bump every published version surface to 0.8.22 and add the changelog section the Release workflow reads.
blockers: Version agreement is a release-gate invariant: package.json, src/version.ts, site/package.json, site/app/_lib/site.ts (SOFTWARE_VERSION), and the README `bun add --global @hraness/message-like-me@X.Y.Z` line must all read 0.8.22 — verified all five; a repo-wide scan finds no other live 0.8.21 reference (remaining hits are historical changelog/publishing records).
site/app/readme.generated.ts embeds the README — a hand-edit would drift; regenerated via the repo's own `bun run sync:readme` (site/scripts/sync-readme.ts).

The Release writer parses CHANGELOG.md with a strict contract (## <version> - YYYY-MM-DD, one summary paragraph then bullets only, bounded bytes, no 'Unreleased'); the new section was validated by calling the real `changelogSection()` parser — it returns a section cleanly.

docs/publishing.md requires the first automated trusted-publisher version be newer than the 0.8.0 bootstrap and the tag be the newest stable semver: 0.8.22 > 0.8.21 (latest release 'Textbutler v0.8.21') — satisfies both.

rounds.design: All six surfaces agree at 0.8.22; generated file regenerated by its own script; changelog section parses; receipt rebound to the bumped package.json (bun.lock unchanged — no dependency moved).
blockers: git diff shows exactly seven files: CHANGELOG.md, README.md, package.json, site/package.json, site/app/_lib/site.ts, site/app/readme.generated.ts, src/version.ts — no unrelated edits, no lockfile drift.
The diff makes no product-behavior change: version constants, one README line, generated HTML mirror, changelog text only.
Receipt binding: only package.json among the 43 covered sources changed; the rebind recomputed all 43 sha256s and re-pinned validation.receiptSha256 to the new current-validation JSON.
acceptedNits: The changelog bullet for the ⚠︎ menu row uses the same literal warning glyph the feature itself ships; the section parser accepts it.

The heavyweight workflow-control-epoch suite hit its 5s timeout once under load during the pre-rebind aggregate run; the file passes standalone (14/14, the same case in <1s) and in the post-rebind aggregate run.
rounds.verification: changelogSection() parses the 0.8.22 section; no lingering live 0.8.21 references; sync:readme output diff is the README change only; pre-rebind bun run check stops at the documented admission gate (491/493 with one additional load flake); post-rebind bun run check evidence in xcb-textbutler-v1-current-check.log.

result: Ship. The bump is a pure version-coordinate change consistent across all six surfaces, with the receipt rebound to the bumped manifest.
